games.name: BARK
games.tagline: ONE BIG MAP, ONE SMALL COMMUNITY
games.shortDesc: One big map, one small community. Enter Bark — a world of the Trelatves. Hang out with others, play at the arcade, and enjoy the world of Bark!
games.fullDesc: Enter Bark, a world of the Trelatves. In Bark, you hang out with others, play at the new arcade, and enjoy the world of Bark!

games.name: Glorp!
games.shortDesc: In this game, you play as a rat. you can travel through sewers, jam out to music, and most importantly, have fun!

games.name: Parakeet Park
games.shortDesc: Snow has fallen down in Parakeet Park! Hop on down and chill out with your friends! Vibe to the music, Dance with the parakeets around the town that grows almost every update! Stay warm out there!
games.fullDesc: Snow has fallen down in Parakeet Park! Hop on down and chill out with up to 19 your friends! Vibe to the holiday music, Go ice skating in the middle of the town, Dance with the parakeets around the town that grows almost every update! The world is ever changing, and you'll be able to meet new NPCs throughout the town! Stay warm out there, for it is chilly!

games.name: The Testevator
games.shortDesc: Explore rooms using a magic elevator, Find hidden easter eggs, Get weirdly confused by dancing frogs, And have fun!
games.fullDesc: Explore rooms using a magic elevator, Find hidden easter eggs, Get weirdly confused by dancing frogs,  Customize your body,  Laugh at strange things, And have fun!

games.name: Prolg!
games.shortDesc: In This game, you play as birds! you can chill, mess around, and check out sick cosmetics!
games.fullDesc: You play as a bird and chill, that's all I have to say.

reviews.author: Bumstronaut

games.name: The Forestman
games.tagline: "Turn on the headlights Terry, Harambe's coming"
games.shortDesc: Run, Hide, Fight, Or Escape. There are many paths you can go down. Which one will you choose? Stay safe from the creatures out there, its looking pretty rough.
games.fullDesc: You're trapped in a forest, but you're not alone. There is something out there, something lurking, something tall, something with big feet, but what? Explore with up to 5 people, and try to escape this dangerous island. Stay safe out there, folks.

games.name: Galaxy War
games.shortDesc:
Galaxy War is currently a game where you can hang out with friends! Visit different planets, and have fun! 
Game Is still in development.
games.fullDesc:
Galaxy War is a game where you hang out with friends and visit different planets! The lobby is the station, where you can join lobbies and change you name, color, etc. There are many roles, like admin, owner, mod, Content Creator, and beta tester that all have their own badges or cosmetics.
Game Is still in development.

games.name: Pyramid People
games.shortDesc: Welcome to Pyramid People, a little VR game made for fun! There will be more game-modes to come, along with more features and cosmetics! This is just a little hangout game!

siteText.extrasForecastDisclaimer: Forecast uses the same algorithm as the in-game system. No manual overrides are shown on this page.
siteText.privacy_p_use: We use the information we collect to review job applications, contact applicants, and improve our services. Application data is sent directly to our team via Discord. We use Meta's User Age Group API to determine whether you are a child, teen, or adult. We use this only to adjust the experience (for example, disabling voice chat for users under 13). The result is stored locally and is never transmitted to our servers.
